text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the dorm kitchen, Eishin Flash was 
tasting her newest cake creation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—I followed the recipe perfectly, yet it's 
just slightly lacking in deep sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even this flavor meets the passing mark, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...We really can't compromise after all. 
This is something everyone's going to eat, 
after all. Let's review the recipe from 
scratch and make adjustments."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now then... We can't let this cake go to 
waste either. As the one who made it, I 
will take full responsibility and eat it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However... this is going to be quite a 
big undertaking... The flavor I'm striving 
for still feels so far away..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as a result of repeated 
prototyping and taste testing, the toll on 
her nutritional balance ended up showing 
on her skin as breakouts.
